implementation_note: Tripod V1 documents and audits existing venue-fit logic. It does not change Rocket Classic 2026 output.

dominant_tripod.effective_scope: Venue-fit interpretation, player audit, narrative support
dominant_tripod.weight_scope: Canonical venueFit subset; 0.85 total subset weight
dominant_tripod.rationale: Detroit Golf Club's 2026 renovated par-70 setup emphasizes approach quality, 150–200-yard play, and controlled modern driving.

dominant_tripod_governance.activation_requirement: Historical validation plus approved engine version change before pre-tournament build
dominant_tripod_governance.applies_to: Future Detroit Golf Club engine runs only

tripod_qualified.definition: Each of SG: Approach, App 150–200, and Total Driving is at or above the 60th percentile versus the eligible field.
tripod_qualified.future_candidate_use: Tier 1 support signal, not a stand-alone scoring override

tripod_supported.definition: Weighted tripod score at or above the 65th percentile and at least two of three component traits at or above the 60th percentile.
tripod_supported.future_candidate_use: Balanced alternative to an all-three hard gate

t2g_no_red_flag.current_use: Do not score, tier-cap, badge, or suppress any player
t2g_no_red_flag.future_candidate_use: Ceiling and variance research feature only

recent_form_variance.definition: Tripod-qualified player with negative recent-form index
recent_form_variance.current_use: Narrative risk disclosure only when source data is available and narrative-eligible
recent_form_variance.future_candidate_use: Variance-band research feature; never silently subtract from VTS

neutral_skill_exception.reason: No numerical definition of exceptional NeutralSkill has been approved.

known_limitations.reason: Top-level source-coverage metadata marks true-SG inputs unavailable for this event build. Player-level values are non-authoritative until source reconciliation is completed.
known_limitations.future_action: Reconcile top-level source-coverage metadata with player-level true-SG values before any V2 governance validation study.
